Data & sources

What these prices mean

Each building represents its city’s median gross rent, not an individual property listing. Buildings and streets are fictional. Income is median household income, not wages or youth income.

U.S. Census Bureau ACS five-year estimates, releases 2021–2024. Adjacent periods overlap. Dollar changes are nominal; statistical significance is not tested. Annual rent divided by median household income is a comparison proxy, not a measured renter burden.
